scope: Bounded real-Paper command-tree/suggestion and world-effect decoding, value assertions and byte-exact re-encoding. No claim of game simulation, physics, combat, Grim or online-account validation.
local_codec_checks: Cached release DustParticleOptions and ExtraCodecs: vector RGB syntax uses alpha 1.0 when converted to packed color; red is -65536 and green is -16711936 from protocol 768.
Cached release ParticleCommand: force sets long_distance=true; the additional always_show field remains false from protocol 769.

Cached release ItemParticleOption and ItemStack codecs: legacy particle input uses SINGLE_ITEM_CODEC and therefore transmits count 1; protocol 775+ uses ItemStackTemplate and preserves requested count 2.
Pinned Paper non-operator msg targets nodes advertise AskServer through protocol 768 and no explicit provider from 769; parser flags and message-child links remain semantically checked.
Default disposable-world TNT uses Destroy in legacy explosion effect data; both modern weighted entries are checked for name, scaling, speed and weight.
explicit_limits: entity_sound_effect was not exercised by the natural pig hurt/death scenario in any release; those events emitted positional sound_effect packets. Its evidence remains independent codec/API fixtures only.
The non-operator command tree checks only the actual permitted parser subset and aliases. Restricted commands and all parser properties are not claimed as live-tested.
Suggestion text/range/transaction/player-match values are checked; tooltip-bearing suggestions were not observed.
World particles cover flame, dust, dust_color_transition and item payloads only. Remaining particle options retain their separate fixture/source-audit coverage.
No privileges, public listener, RCON, account login, plugin installation, or production world was used.

preserved_boundary_attempts.note: Initial smoke. Decoding succeeded; 26.2 harness expectations for always_show and packed alpha were corrected.
Byte-exact real-packet encoding succeeded. Harness expectations for default Destroy, single-item counts and the pinned Paper provider subset were corrected. No production codec changed.

explicitly_unexercised: entity_sound_effect (tagged pig damage/death did not yield a value-matched EntitySound packet)

commands.command: execute at Rustwire run fill -2 199 -2 6 199 2 minecraft:stone replace

commands.command: execute at Rustwire run setblock 2 200 2 minecraft:stone replace

commands.command: execute at Rustwire run setblock 2 200 2 minecraft:air destroy

commands.name: entity_prepare
commands.command: execute at Rustwire run summon minecraft:pig 2.5 200 0.5 {Tags:["rustwire_surface"],NoAI:1b,NoGravity:1b}

commands.name: entity_sound
commands.command: execute at Rustwire run damage @e[type=minecraft:pig,tag=rustwire_surface,distance=..8,limit=1] 2 minecraft:generic

commands.name: explosion
commands.command: execute at Rustwire run summon minecraft:tnt 4.5 200 0.5 {Tags:["rustwire_surface_tnt"],NoGravity:1b,Motion:[0d,0d,0d]}
